sve_mode_audit.scope: Every selected SVE page contains CheckSVEEnabled; on SME-only CPUs this requires streaming mode. Conditional non-streaming checks and feature-dependent operands still require per-encoding review. No general SVE support is inferred.

limits: Official Apple clang enabled-feature exports select candidate canonical forms, not exhaustive Apple hardware capabilities, assembler operands or per-OS availability. Untagged reference forms are candidates, including system forms with feature-dependent operands. Privileged compiler features and accepted HINT/system-register syntax are not hardware validation. SME admits streaming SVE candidates without enabling general non-streaming SVE. Mode, operand, FP, memory and exception semantics need separate verification. Apple-private operations and full hardware membership remain open. A form count is not application or macOS compatibility.
